scope: Thor hammer complete feature audit, emphasizing multiplayer

fixes.issue: GuanLei actor replication crashed the server: RecallAt/CaughtAt were not reflected
Shared lightning arc had the same unreflected NetBrightness/NetChargeRatio fields
100ms catch phase could be skipped before actor destruction under network loss
fixes.fix: Ordered reliable catch receipt; existing one-shot guard prevents duplicates

fixes.issue: Catch/flight audio waited for the entire high-resolution visual load
fixes.fix: Independent high-priority sound load plus equipped-weapon preloading

fixes.issue: Outbound hammer could fall past world bounds and leave the weapon permanently away
fixes.fix: Authority retires below KillZ/outside bounds; grounded hammers still have no timeout

fixes.issue: Recall and heavy shockwave used incomplete friendly filtering
fixes.fix: Use shared enemy predicate, including companion/team protection

fixes.issue: JiLei V14 mesh suffix no longer matched the aura finder
LeiXi buff replicated but remote equipment core brightness was not updated
Approved GuanLei V12 closed-crown model was not published; catalog still used V9
fixes.fix: Saved V12 mesh/PBR and regenerated the matching framed production icon; updated the actual catalog

fixes.issue: GuanLei collapsed UVs and both seats invalid tangent frames/fallback settings
fixes.fix: Repaired 32717 UV polygons; baked orthogonal tangents while retaining original source geometry/normals; explicitly selected full-detail Nanite fallback

fixes.issue: Prior conductive-grip audit found duplicate listen-host release procs, mutable item snapshots, stale field pulses, missing remote grip profile and arc publication dependent on cosmetic loading

contracts: Heavy attack multiplier follows player heavy-strike skill level.
GuanLei landing = heavy physical component + native lightning magic component; native lightning uses 100% magic attack with the applicable damage modifiers, without a second heavy multiplier.
JiLei converts the ordinary heavy plus its native lightning into the intended magic payload once.
Native, thrown and JiLei lightning add 2 electrified stacks; overload threshold is 5. Echo adds 0.25s to base overload stun and retains 2 stacks.
LeiXi grants existing magic inspiration for 10s; additional receipts refresh, never stack.
ZhenTing extra strikes use diameter spacing and 0.25/0.50/0.75s sequencing; committed launch direction and item snapshot survive switching.
Switching active slots preserves the equipped thrown instance. Removing it from equipment retires the world actor.
Recall is nonblocking and lasts 1s; each enemy is hit once. Beyond 60m the entire return is transport only.
Static Field and Coil use enemy-only targeting and authoritative release/pulse processing.

validation.profiles: Isolated audit profiles; UDP peers use private per-run UserDir save roots

limits: NullRHI/NoSound network runs check actors, RPCs, status/damage and audio event dispatch. They do not accept rendered hand animation, material appearance or audible mixing.
Wire fixtures seed deterministic profiles and exercise production combat RPCs; complete inventory UI/profile-upload transactions are not covered.
Level-transition cleanup was checked via EndPlay fixture, not live ServerTravel. Rejoin/late observer joins and more than one client were not exercised.
No FPS/VRAM benchmark. Both seats retain their detailed Nanite source and full-detail fallback; this is not a low-poly optimization claim.
Earlier failed receipts are retained. Test-only fixes covered initial queued movement, unresolved target references, duplicate delegate binding and counting previous fading effects.
